compound of door and standing guardian

items.question: Which paired faculties are assigned to the guardians of the four doors?
premises: medhā and prajñā are paired faculties
two pairs are assigned at the doors
items.inference: The verse assigns two pairs of medhā-prajñā faculties to the guardians of the four doors.
uncertainties: exact pairing and door order are not specified by the verse
items.plain_english: Two each of medhā, prajñā, and related faculties are placed at the guardians of the four doors.
